summary: T16-02 round 10, reviewed at ef9a2e1f73a3. All five story checks passed when I ran them. These were make -C paper check, lint, overlap, test (874 passed) and the default all target, which ran numbers, lint, overlap, test and pdf in that order. I did not re-inspect the source, so criteria other than command results are judged only from these runs and the previous-round resolutions. I found nothing new.

checks.evidence: ruff check passed, ruff format --check found 12 files already formatted, and mypy --strict reported no issues in 12 source files.

checks.criterion: make -C paper lint (the manuscript passes the prose linter)
make -C paper overlap (the manuscript passes the overlap check)
checks.evidence: overlap_check.py: 15 .tex files, 0 abstracts, 0 references without an abstract skipped; no run of 12 or more shared words. The record file is empty, so no abstract was compared.

checks.criterion: make -C paper test (the test files exist and pass)
checks.evidence: 874 passed in 0.85s. test_lint_prose.py, test_overlap_check.py and test_tex_prose.py were among the collected files. I did not re-check that the tests failed before the scripts existed. That is judged from the commit order, with fbf3c38 adding the tests first.

checks.criterion: make -C paper (all runs numbers, lint, overlap, test and pdf in that order)
checks.evidence: The output ran numbers.py, lint, overlap, pytest (874 passed) and tectonic in that order. check_log.py then reported main.log clean.

checks.criterion: AC1 and AC2: shared extraction module, and the 22.6 lint rules with exit 1 on any finding
checks.evidence: Judged only from the passing tests and the clean runs, covering the 874 tests including test_tex_prose.py and test_lint_prose.py. I did not read the source. The earlier-round fixes appear covered by regression tests in the suite.

checks.criterion: AC4 and AC5: overlap check and the {"references": {}} record file
checks.evidence: test_overlap_check.py passes, and the overlap run printed the summary line including the count of references without an abstract. I did not read reference-verification.json myself, but the overlap run read it, and it reported 0 abstracts.

checks.criterion: AC6: README gains a line for each new command
checks.evidence: I did not read paper/README.md this round. The previous rounds raised no finding on it.
